name: Validation & formatting
description: Validate IBANs, BICs, card numbers, emails, phone numbers, postcodes and national IDs with check digits and normalised values; format and parse numbers, currencies and phone numbers by locale.

operations.label: Validate
operations.description: Check one value: iban, bic, card, email, phone, postcode or national_id. Returns valid, the normalised value, the reason it is invalid and type-specific details (card issuer, IBAN country, phone country code, formatted ID, …).

inputs.name: type
inputs.label: Type
inputs.description: What the value is.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The value to check (spaces and dashes are allowed where usual).

inputs.name: country
inputs.label: Country
inputs.description: Postcode: the ISO country (US, GB, CA, AU, NZ, DE, FR, NL, IE, ES, IT, …). Phone: the default country (ISO code or calling code such as 64) for numbers without +.

inputs.name: id_type
inputs.label: ID type
inputs.description: For national_id: which scheme.

outputs.name: normalized
outputs.label: Normalised value
outputs.description: The value in its standard form (IBAN without spaces, E.164 phone, upper-case postcode with standard spacing, digits-only card number, …).

outputs.name: reason
outputs.label: Reason
outputs.description: Why the value is invalid (empty when valid).

outputs.name: details
outputs.label: Details
outputs.description: Type-specific facts: iban country, bban and formatted; bic bank_code, country, branch; card issuer, last4, masked; email local, domain; phone country_code, national_number, international; national_id formatted.

operations.label: Validate many
operations.description: Check a list of { type, value } entries at once (e.g. every field of an onboarding form) and get one result per entry plus whether all are valid.

inputs.name: items
inputs.label: Items
inputs.description: List of { "type": "email", "value": "…", "name"?: "label", "country"?: "NZ", "id_type"?: "nz_ird" }.

inputs.name: country
inputs.label: Default country
inputs.description: Used for phone and postcode entries without their own country.

operations.label: Format number
operations.description: Format a number for a locale: grouping and decimal separators, percent (0.25 → 25%), currency, or compact (1.2K) notation.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The number. For percent, 0.25 is 25%.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.label: Locale
inputs.description: BCP 47 locale, e.g. en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP.

inputs.name: style
inputs.label: Style
inputs.description: Plain number, percent or currency.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.label: Currency
inputs.description: For the currency style: ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR, NZD, JPY, …).

inputs.name: minimum_fraction_digits
inputs.label: Minimum decimals
inputs.description: Optional: at least this many decimal places.

inputs.name: maximum_fraction_digits
inputs.label: Maximum decimals
inputs.description: Optional: at most this many decimal places (rounded).

inputs.name: use_grouping
inputs.label: Thousands separators
inputs.description: Group digits (1,234,567).

inputs.name: notation
inputs.label: Notation
inputs.description: Standard, compact (1.2M), scientific or engineering.

operations.label: Format currency
operations.description: Format an amount of money for a locale and currency, with the currency's usual decimals (JPY has none) and symbol, code or name.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Amount
inputs.description: The amount.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.label: Currency
inputs.description: ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR, GBP, NZD, AUD, JPY, …).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.label: Locale
inputs.description: BCP 47 locale, e.g. en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP.

inputs.name: display
inputs.label: Show currency as
inputs.description: Symbol ($), narrow symbol, ISO code (NZD) or name (New Zealand dollars).

inputs.name: accounting
inputs.label: Accounting negatives
inputs.description: Show negative amounts in brackets, e.g. ($1,234.50).

inputs.name: minimum_fraction_digits
inputs.label: Minimum decimals
inputs.description: Optional: at least this many decimal places.

inputs.name: maximum_fraction_digits
inputs.label: Maximum decimals
inputs.description: Optional: at most this many decimal places (rounded).

operations.label: Parse number
operations.description: Read a number typed the way a locale writes it: "1.234,56" in de-DE and "1,234.56" in en-US are both 1234.56. Handles currency symbols and codes, percent (12% → 0.12), brackets and minus signs, and local digits.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: The number as text.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.label: Locale
inputs.description: BCP 47 locale, e.g. en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP.

outputs.name: value
outputs.label: Value
outputs.description: The number (empty when the text is not a number).

outputs.name: valid
outputs.label: Valid
outputs.description: Whether the text could be read as a number.

operations.label: Format phone
operations.description: Normalise a phone number to E.164 (+64211234567), or format it in international (+64 21 123 4567) or national (021 123 4567) style with simple grouping. North American numbers use (415) 555-0132.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Phone number
inputs.description: As typed: with + and country code, or national with Country set.

inputs.name: country
inputs.label: Default country
inputs.description: ISO country (NZ, US, GB, …) or calling code (64) for numbers without +.

inputs.name: format
inputs.label: Format
inputs.description: Output style.

outputs.name: formatted
outputs.label: Formatted
outputs.description: Empty when the number is not valid.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.label: Reason
outputs.description: Why the number is invalid (empty when valid).

summary: Check identifiers before they reach other systems: IBAN (mod 97 and country length), BIC, card numbers (Luhn and issuer), email syntax, phone numbers (E.164), postcodes for 26 countries and 13 national ID and tax number schemes, each with a normalised value and a reason when invalid. Also locale-aware number, currency and phone formatting and number parsing.
purpose: Catch typing errors early and store identifiers in one normalised form; show numbers and money the way each audience reads them.
recommended_for: Supplier and customer onboarding, payment details, HR and KYC forms, imports, and any message or document that shows amounts.
setup_notes: Pure computation: no network, data or secrets. Nothing to configure after installing.
Validation checks format and check digits only: a valid IBAN or card number is well-formed, not proven to exist. Email checks are syntax only (no DNS or mailbox check).
Number formatting uses the server's Unicode CLDR data (Intl), so results match browsers.
